scope: Primary-source research notes, not locally reproduced results or a model ranking

sources.title: Generated, Parallel, Scalable? A Study of Agentic AI-Generated Julia Code on Supercomputers
sources.reported_setup: Agentic Julia documentation-assisted generation for pi integration, tiled GEMM and tiled Cholesky; Base.Threads, MPI.jl and Dagger.jl; single-node and two-node scaling.
sources.reported_finding: Small executable cases did not guarantee larger-scale reliability; authors report dependency, task-granularity, scheduling, deadlock, oversubscription and memory failures.
sources.local_inference: Kernel evaluation should separate functional correctness from scale, allocation limits, synchronization and steady-state performance. Our small stencil passes do not establish general HPC competence.
sources.limits: No reproduction here. Do not import paper model-parameter claims into our hardware sizing without checking the original model card. Different models, hardware and workloads from our 4B/Mantle study.

sources.title: KernelAgentBench repository
sources.reported_setup: Julia Gray-Scott optimization with CPU, CUDA and KernelAbstractions tracks; corrected out-of-place baseline, correctness gate before speed, finite revision budget, separate JIT/end-to-end and steady-state timing.
sources.local_inference: A useful external methodology reference for bounded public-feedback kernel optimization, particularly avoiding in-place cross-block races and timing incorrect kernels.
sources.limits: Repository description, not a reproduced result or demonstrated model-quality improvement. Current stated GPU evaluator targets NVIDIA, not our Mantle backend. Public tasks may be contaminated.

sources.title: A new LLM benchmark for Julia programming
sources.reported_followup: 2026 discussion explicitly distinguishes functional pass@1 from idiomatic Julia code.
sources.local_inference: Do not label unit-test success as idiomatic, maintainable code or visually good Makie output. These need separately defined evaluation.
sources.limits: Author/community methodology discussion only, not a new local benchmark result.
